nfl.oneThing: The Bears traded for Jeffery Simmons, giving up a 2027 first-round pick, a 2027 fourth and a 2028 first to get the Titans' defensive tackle.

headlines.title: Bears land Jeffery Simmons from Tennessee
headlines.summary: Chicago acquired DT Jeffery Simmons and a 2028 fifth-round pick from Tennessee. In return the Bears sent a 2027 first-round pick, a 2027 fourth-round pick and a 2028 first-round pick. Simmons has since addressed his past comments about Caleb Williams. Two years ago he nicknamed the Bears quarterback "Painted Nails", and he now says it was "just smack talk". The Bears are 5-2 and the NFC's No. 5 seed.
headlines.whyItMatters: It is a big commitment of picks for an interior defensive upgrade, and the Bears are now in the NFC playoff picture as a contender.

headlines.title: Panthers relieve Ejiro Evero as defensive coordinator
headlines.summary: Carolina moved on from defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero on Friday. Defensive line coach Todd Wash takes over on an interim basis. The Panthers are 3-4 and sit fourth in the NFC playoff picture, with 10 games left. Carolina lost 27–19 to the Packers on Thursday night.
headlines.whyItMatters: The defence is the focus for the rest of the season, and Wash's interim run will show whether the change makes a difference.

headlines.title: Jeremiyah Love set to return for Cardinals against Cowboys
headlines.summary: Arizona rookie running back Jeremiyah Love is cleared to play Sunday at Dallas after missing two games with an ankle injury. Coach Mike LaFleur says he will have no restrictions. The matchup suits Arizona's run game: the Cowboys have allowed over 1,000 rushing yards and average 4.7 yards per carry, while the Cardinals average 3.7 as a team. Dallas is also missing key interior linemen.
headlines.whyItMatters: Love is the Cardinals' main rushing option, and a strong game could help an offence that is 2-5 and 14th in the NFC.

headlines.title: Browns and Steelers meet with both sides at 5-2
headlines.summary: Cleveland and Pittsburgh are both 5-2 and meet in Pittsburgh on Sunday, with a 1 p.m. kickoff. The Browns have not won a regular-season game at Pittsburgh since 2003. A win would give them their first season sweep of the Steelers since 1988. The Browns have won two of their past three games, and the Steelers have a three-game winning streak.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Browns are the AFC's No. 3 seed and the Steelers are No. 6, so the result will matter in the division race.

teamNews.text: He is listed as questionable for Sunday at the Jets. Coach Klint Kubiak says the Raiders have until Saturday to decide whether to activate him. If he can't play, Dont'e Thornton Jr. could see more snaps.

recaps.text: Jordan Love threw for 288 yards and three touchdowns, and Green Bay pulled away from Carolina in a game decided by one score. The Packers' passing game did the heavy lifting, with Christian Watson catching eight passes for 113 yards. Josh Jacobs also scored. Bryce Young had a solid day for the Panthers, and Chuba Hubbard scored and ran for 81 yards. Carolina's defence was led by Zakee Wheatley, who had an interception. The Packers improve to 5-3, while the Panthers drop to 3-4 and fourth in the NFC.

standouts.name: Jordan Love
standouts.why: Love threw three touchdowns and only one interception in a one-score game, and the Packers' offence depended on him.

contextCard.title: How injured reserve works
contextCard.body: Injured reserve (IR) holds players who are out for an extended period. A player on IR must miss a minimum number of games before he can return. Once that period ends, the team can activate him, or it can open a 21-day window in which he can practise with the team before being activated. This is different from a designation to return, which can only be given to players who are eligible to come back.

nba.oneThing: Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant is out at least four weeks with a grade 2 left hamstring strain, after he was hurt in his first game back against Memphis.

headlines.title: Ja Morant out at least four weeks
headlines.summary: Morant has a grade 2 left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in four weeks, which means he misses at least the next 15 games. He was hurt in the fourth quarter of Portland's 124–103 loss to Memphis, his former team. Coach Micah Nori says Morant felt a twinge before leaving. Morant had scored a season-high 23 points in a win over the Lakers and was averaging 15.8 points and 5.5 assists in four games with Portland. The Trail Blazers have the NBA's No. 3 offence through Thursday and open a four-game road trip against the Jazz on Saturday.
headlines.whyItMatters: Portland is 3-1 and has been one of the early stories of the season. Without Morant, the backcourt will lean on Jrue Holiday and the backup guards.

headlines.title: Early-season injury run hits key players
headlines.summary: CBS reports that the early season has been an unprecedented run of injuries, with several stars hurt less than two weeks into the 2026–27 season. Tyrese Haliburton is out with a left hamstring strain, Marcus Smart is out with a left forearm strain, and Jaylon Tyson is out with a right ankle sprain. Jaylen Brown is doubtful for the Knicks game. The injuries are changing how some teams are shaping their rotations.
headlines.whyItMatters: Teams are already reworking their rotations, and the standings in both conferences are still close.

headlines.title: Thunder sign Ochai Agbaji after wing injuries
headlines.summary: Oklahoma City agreed to sign Ochai Agbaji to fill its open roster spot after Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace were injured last Sunday. Agbaji was waived by the Knicks at the end of preseason. The Thunder are 4-1 and third in the West. The signing gives them a wing option while their starters are out.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Thunder need depth on the wing while two starters are out, and Agbaji gives them an immediate option.

teamNews.title: Spurs beat Jazz in overtime
teamNews.text: Victor Wembanyama scored 36 points as San Antonio beat Utah 117–111 in overtime. The Spurs are 3-2 and sixth in the West. Next up are the Timberwolves, who are dealing with injuries of their own.

recaps.text: Cameron Boozer had a triple-double with 18 points, 12 rebounds and 12 assists, and Cedric Coward added 17 points, seven rebounds and three steals. Portland's Deni Avdija had 24 points and seven assists, but Morant's injury in the fourth quarter took away the Trail Blazers' most dangerous backcourt player at a bad time.

recaps.keyLine: Harden 24 pts, 5 reb, 4 ast · Mitchell 22 pts, 3 reb, 3 ast · Okongwu 29 pts, 12 reb, 2 ast · Alexander-Walker 25 pts, 3 reb, 1 ast
recaps.text: Atlanta beat Cleveland 114–111 in a close finish. Onyeka Okongwu scored 29 points and grabbed 12 rebounds, and Nickeil Alexander-Walker added 25. James Harden and Donovan Mitchell led the Cavaliers with 24 and 22 points. The win is flagged as an upset.

recaps.text: New Orleans beat Sacramento 132–120. Darius Acuff Jr. had 34 points and 14 assists for the Kings, and Domantas Sabonis had 15 rebounds. Jeremiah Fears had 22 points, 13 assists and four blocks for the Pelicans. Sacramento is 0–5 and has lost five straight games.

standouts.name: Cameron Boozer
standouts.why: Boozer's triple-double was the most complete line of the night, and he led Memphis past a team that had been playing well.

standouts.name: Darius Acuff Jr.
standouts.why: Acuff's 34 points and 14 assists kept Sacramento in a game it ended up losing, and he had a lot to do with it.

standouts.name: Onyeka Okongwu
standouts.why: Okongwu's 29 points and 12 rebounds carried Atlanta through a close finish against Cleveland.

standouts.name: Jeremiah Fears
standouts.why: Fears had 13 assists and four blocks, and he controlled the game in New Orleans' win.
